title: Zephyr: define portable LoRa CAD extension and wire CSMA pipeline
description: LICHEN's TX pipeline calls lora_cad() and lr1110/lora_sim/lora_renode initialize a .cad member, but Zephyr v3.7/v4.1 struct lora_driver_api exposes neither. Current code therefore fails strict Zephyr compilation (implicit lora_cad declaration; nonexistent .cad initializer). Define a bounded, ABI-safe LICHEN CAD extension or HAL dispatch for LR1110/sim/renode/loopback and supported external radios; make CAD timeout/error fail closed, integrate the existing lichen_csma retry/backoff state machine, and add focused busy/clear/timeout/error/cancellation tests.
notes: Implemented ABI-safe LICHEN-owned CAD dispatch: bounded 4-device static registry with mutex, idempotent registration, fail-closed missing/error handling, and no changes to Zephyr struct lora_driver_api. Wired LR1110, lora_sim, lora_renode, and loopback registration under CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_L2; external drivers can register via lichen_lora_cad_register(). LR1110 uses exactly 3 CAD symbols and maps incomplete CAD to -ETIMEDOUT/busy after restoring standby/IRQ state. Integrated lichen_csma_acquire into L2 TX with cryptographic RNG, 10 ms exponential backoff through BE=5, retry limit 3, clear/busy/timeout/error/cancel transitions, shutdown recheck, and TX-completion state update. Also corrected the three custom drivers recv_async signatures to the standard Zephyr user_data ABI discovered by strict compile. Validation: host ASan/UBSan CSMA ctest PASS 1/1 (clear, busy, timeout, exhaustion, RNG/error, concurrency/cancel); relevant cppcheck source pass (test-only assertWithSideEffect diagnostics); git diff --check PASS; no remaining .cad initializers or lora_cad() calls. Local Zephyr 4.1/SDK 0.16.8 nRF52840 ping_l2 object compile PASS for lora_loopback.c, csma.c, lora_l2_tx.c. Local nucleo_wl55jc Renode strict object/library compile PASS with L2 disabled and again with CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_L2 enabled using the Renode overlays. LR1110 object validation is unavailable in the shared 4.1 tree because its loramac-node LR1110 source submodule is absent; cppcheck covers the edited source. AWS workstation was not used because it is externally owned. No shared-worktree collision; active hal/CMakeLists.txt, hal_airtime.c, airtime.h, and l2/Kconfig were preserved untouched.
close_reason: Portable CAD extension, fail-closed CSMA pipeline, driver wiring, focused state-machine tests, and strict available driver compiles complete.
